purpose: Teach: プライス/デイリー/タイムリー/コントラスト/不合格/日本経済新聞/レジスト/博覧

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文のプライス、つまり投稿料も意識しろ
lines.en: Ren — be conscious of publication costs when you're evaluating papers.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Leans slightly forward. Not unkind, but exacting. The weight of experience settling into each word. Expects Ren to listen and absorb.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。デイリー実験ログを残します
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep detailed daily experiment logs.
lines.style: Quiet, attentive. Immediate and genuine. The slight nervousness of a younger person speaking to someone whose opinion matters. Notes the instruction, already thinking ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、タイムリーな研究テーマを選べ
lines.en: Ren — choose research topics with current relevance. Don't chase yesterday's questions.
lines.style: Steady gaze. Light tap of conviction on the instruction. Warm but unbending. Not lecturing — advising someone he believes can take it seriously.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。図表のコントラストを丁寧に調整します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure the contrast in the charts and tables is precise.
lines.style: Respectful, taking note. Slight nod. The earnestness of someone younger translating feedback into action. Careful not to over-promise.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、不合格論文の原因を分析しろ
lines.en: Ren — analyze why papers get rejected. Understand the patterns.
lines.style: Deliberate pause before speaking. Direct but not sharp. The tone of someone who has seen many submissions fail for the same reasons. Expects Ren to think critically.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。日本経済新聞の電子版も活用します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also use the digital edition of the Nikkei to stay current on economic research.
lines.style: Quick, respectful intake of breath. Already problem-solving aloud. Shows he's listening and thinking beyond the immediate instruction. Polite but purposeful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、フォトレジスト技術にも理解を深めろ
lines.en: Ren — deepen your understanding of photoresist technology. Don't leave gaps.
lines.style: Slight narrowing of attention. Each word deliberate. Not a suggestion — a standard to meet. The tone of someone who notices when understanding is incomplete.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。博覧会のサイドイベントにも参加します
lines.en: Yes. I'll attend the side events at the expo as well.
lines.style: Final commitment, slightly quieter. The earnestness of someone who hears the full weight of the feedback and intends to act. Trailing slightly, like he's already planning his next step.
